summary: Frontend-only regression for HomeBundleStrip whole-card click fix + Apply.jsx ?paket= preselection. All 6 requested scenarios PASS. Card body clicks, CTA clicks, preselection (visa+insurance+eSIM+10% paket indirimi), totals, idempotence, and /basvuru regression (precheck happy path) all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx effect at line ~512 depends on visaTypes.length; if /visa-types call fails, the paket preselect never fires. Consider not gating on visaTypes for insurance/eSIM at least.
Apply.jsx is >1500 lines - candidate to split into smaller modules (steps, sidebar, hooks) per file-size guideline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home has 3 bundle cards data-testid=home-bundle-pack_standard/comfort/long, each is a single <a> wrapping the whole card content; inner CTA is a <span data-testid=home-bundle-cta-...>. /basvuru?paket=<id> preselects insurance + esimQty[esim]=1 + adult traveler visa_type_id, shows success toast, applies 10% paket indirimi. Verified totals: pack_standard=6.360₺, pack_long=11.828,50₺. Idempotence guarded by bundleApplied useRef so manual insurance changes persist. Precheck (01.12.2026/10.12.2026/01.01.2030) shows precheck-result-ok and carries into wizard. Only 1 'En çok seçilen' badge across cards; hero-subtitle-0 visible (rotates).
